_about: Demo dataset for FoundIt: a university campus, October 2026, all times UTC. Fictional; no real people. 'expected' records what a careful human would conclude and is used by scripts/eval_matching.py.

reports.private_details: The keyring has a little metal tower charm.

true_pairs: same backpack, different words (navy school bag); private details agree
same phone: cracked corner, engineering building, dog on lock screen
same wallet: tri-fold = folds in three; student card + green bus/transport card
same bottle: green, Sports Centre, NASA ~ space sticker; lost report has no date
plausible_pairs: sparse lost report vs rich found report: compatible but too little to be sure
decoys: found the day BEFORE it was lost, other building, explicitly no keyring
looks identical publicly, but the private keychain detail contradicts
different brand (iPhone vs Samsung), different case and lock screen
different handle (wooden vs plastic) and place
